# The Lemon Index

> Car reliability from public data. The Lemon Index = NHTSA safety complaints per 100,000 U.S. sales, vs the average car of the same model years (100 = average).

- [The Most Reliable Cars, According to 1.6 Million Owner Complaints](https://lemonindex.com/studies/most-reliable-cars/): Toyota 4Runner 26, Lexus ES 27, Lexus brand 30, Tesla brand 322 (est.)
- [The Most Reliable Electric Cars](https://lemonindex.com/electric/): 22 EVs by NHTSA complaints per car sold, best Tesla Model 3 203, plus fires, yearly cost and driver-assist crash reports
- [Engine code lookup](https://lemonindex.com/check-engine-light/): what any OBD-II trouble code means, how serious it is, and which cars owners report it on most in NHTSA complaints
- [Free engine illustrations](https://lemonindex.com/images/): free BMW engine illustrations, CC BY 4.0 (AI-generated, credit The Lemon Index)
- [BMW engines by year](https://lemonindex.com/engines/bmw/): every BMW engine (N54, N55, B58, N63 ...) by model year: US versions and specs (EPA), owner complaints (NHTSA) and a YouTube score
- [Supercar engines by year](https://lemonindex.com/engines/supercars/): 39 supercar engines (Ferrari F154, Lamborghini V10, McLaren M838T, Nissan VR38DETT ...) matched to their cars (EPA), with a YouTube owner score by model year, NHTSA recalls and automaker repair notes
- [Performance car engines by year](https://lemonindex.com/engines/performance/): 48 performance-car engines (Hellcat, Coyote, LS3, LS7, 2UR-GSE, EJ257, S65, S85 ...) matched to their cars (EPA), with a YouTube owner score by model year, NHTSA recalls and automaker repair notes
- [Method](https://lemonindex.com/method/)
